1 About Us
We’re a passionate team of experienced agriculture scientists, extension officers, AI en-
gineers, and innovators using Gen AI to bridge knowledge gaps, empower farmers and
agriculture input company (stakeholders), and drive sustainable farming forward. Started
during March 2025.
1.1 Vision
To empower every Indian smallholder farmer and agri-input enterprise through the trans-
formative potential of Generative AI, fostering a future of inclusive and sustainable agri-
culture.
1.2 Mission
To build Generative AI-powered conversational voice agents that deliver real-time, per-
sonalized, and trustworthy agricultural solutions in regional Indian languages.
1.3 Values
Innovation: Continuously advancing Gen AI technology to revolutionize agricultural in-
telligence.
Quality: Ensuring accuracy, authenticity, and excellence in every Gen AI-powered
interaction.
Real time: Providing instant, expert-backed agricultural support when it matters
most.
Sustainability: Promoting eco-friendly farming practices and responsible input rec-
ommendations.
Trust: Building credibility with farmers, agri-businesses through trusted Gen AI-
driven guidance.

2 Solutions
2.1 Uniqueness
Farm Vaidya building the Zero language, zero literacy and Zero digital barrier voice
agents to enable small holder farmers access the realtime information.
2.2 Voice Agent
We are building an AI-powered conversational voice agent that enables agri-input orga-
nizations to provide round-the-clock customer support in regional languages. The voice
agent helps farmers easily access product information and clarify doubts through natural
voice conversations, even in low-literacy environments.
By operating 24/7 and continuously learning from interactions, it improves customer
satisfaction, reduces the workload on support teams, and enables scalable, efficient en-
gagement across rural and semi-urban regions.
We support multilingual interactions in English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi,
Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Odia, and Punjabi, enabling inclusive and acces-
sible communication across diverse regions of India.
We use data provided by specific agri-input organizations to build voice agents, ensur-
ing that responses are accurate, relevant, and aligned with clients products and services.
This approach enables customized, organization-specific interactions while maintaining
data privacy and delivering reliable information to end users.
We offer three voice agents through telephone, website, and mobile application, en-
abling seamless voice-based interaction across multiple channels.
2.3 Telephone Voice Agent
Our telephone-based voice agent allow farmers and stakeholders to access product infor-
mation and customer support through simple phone calls. It is designed for rural and
low-literacy users, delivers responses in regional languages, and operates 24/7 without hu-
man intervention, ensuring wide reach and consistent support even in areas with limited
internet access. Even uneducated and illiterate farmers are also access the telephony.
2.3.1 Use Cases
•Provide 24/7 product and advisory support via simple phone calls
4
•Enable low-literacy farmers to access information in local languages
•Reduce human call-center load for agri-input companies and institutions
•Disseminate scheme details, input availability, and advisory messages at scale
•Ensure last-mile outreach in low-internet and rural connectivity regions
2.4 Website Voice Agent
The website voice agent enables users to interact with the organization’s digital platform
using natural voice commands. It helps visitors quickly discover product details, services,
and organizational information, improving accessibility, engagement, and overall user
experience for educated users, partners, and employees.
2.4.1 Use Cases
•Answer visitor queries on products, services, schemes, and technologies instantly
•Capture visitor requirements and interests during exhibitions and online campaigns
•Guide dealers, employees, and partners through product catalogs using voice
•Assist researchers and students in navigating institutional websites hands-free
•Provide real-time analytics on visitor intent and frequently asked questions
2.5 Mobile Application Voice Agent
The mobile application voice agent provides a hands-free, voice-enabled experience within
agricultural mobile apps. Users can ask questions, receive spoken guidance, and navi-
gate app features effortlessly while on the move, increasing convenience, adoption, and
continuous engagement.
2.5.1 Use Cases
•Enable farmers to ask product usage questions while working in the field
•Support extension staff with hands-free access to crop advisories and protocols
•Help FPO members navigate apps using simple voice commands
•Deliver voice-based alerts on best practices, inputs, and seasonal recommendations
•Increase app adoption by simplifying complex features through spoken guidance
5
2.6 ChatBot
The AI-powered chatbot focuses on structured, text-based engagement across digital
channels such as websites, mobile apps, and messaging platforms. It assists stakeholders
by answering product-related queries, usage instructions, and service requests in local
languages, ensuring clarity and accuracy.
Designed for high-volume interactions, the chatbot handles repetitive queries effi-
ciently, allowing human teams to focus on complex cases. Its adaptive learning capability
helps refine responses based on user behavior, enabling scalable and reliable digital sup-
port across diverse geographies.
2.6.1 Use Cases
•Answer repetitive product, dosage, and usage queries instantly via text
•Support dealers and employees with quick access to technical information
•Handle high-volume stakeholder queries during campaigns and seasonal peaks
•Assist students and researchers with structured, document-based information
•Generate insights on customer needs through query and interaction analytics
3 Products
At FarmVaidya, we are building india’s first agricultural based ASR (Automatic Speech
Recognisation). Unlike generic speech recognition systems, this ASR understands regional
agricultural terminology, local crop names, dialects, and rural accents, enabling farmers
to interact with digital platforms effortlessly through voice.
3.1 Project: Rythuvaani
Rythuvaani is building a Telugu agriculture domain-specific dataset for building the
Speech-to-Text (STT) system that understands conversational speech in all regional di-
alects.
We are collecting 30,000 hours of conversational agricultural audio from all 59 districts,
ensuring a minimum of 500 hours per district to accurately capture every local dialect
and speech variation.
6
This extensive dataset will be transformed into verified audio-text pairs for fine-tuning
advanced open-source STT models.
This dataset and STT model will directly empower 10 million farmers in Andhra
Pradesh and Telangana.
Farmers will be able to interact with conversational voice agents for crop advisory,
input access, market information, and government schemes.
Governments and agri-tech companies will have access to a scalable, indigenous AI
infrastructure built specifically for agriculture.
4 Founders
4.1 Dr Ramadugu Praveen
Founder and CEO
Dr Ramadugu Praveen has 9 years of horticultural educational experience, including a
PhD in Horticulture, which has provided him with a strong foundation in agricultural sci-
ence, technology, and sustainable farming practices. His academic journey has deepened
his understanding of the challenges involved in knowledge dissemination and highlighted
the need for innovative solutions in the agriculture sector.
In addition to his education, he has over 14 years of experience working across diver-
sified institutions, including banking, ICAR KVK, SAU KVK, private companies, and
entrepreneurship, engaging directly with farmers at the grassroots level.
Through these experiences, he has witnessed firsthand the gaps in accessing timely and
reliable agricultural information for both farmers and stakeholders in the agri-business
ecosystem. This realization led to the creation of Farm Vaidya, where he harnesses
Gen AI-driven voice technology to bridge these gaps and ensure seamless, real-time, and
accessible agricultural knowledge for all.

Interns work closely with experienced teams, focusing on applied learning, problem-

Built-in analytics from voice and chat interactions offer insights into customer queries
and product demand, helping organizations strengthen engagement, optimize support
performance, and drive sales growth.
